edition: ISS Pro Evolution 2 Europe, ISS26 0.9.6 test
objective: Enter Master League; choose any club except Manchester United; reach Buy Players; highlight FC Kryvbas; visit all 22 FC Kryvbas players without buying anybody.
notAllowed: Claim success from visual difference or raw 0x29 group alone

stages.goal: Locate MASTER LEAGUE; do not choose MATCH MODE
stages.safety: Know current cursor and confirm mapping from screenshot

stages.goal: Open NEW GAME or isolated exam save
stages.safety: Do not load or overwrite real memory card

stages.goal: Choose any club EXCEPT Manchester United
stages.candidateKeys: LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN, confirm only after visible name
stages.safety: Explicitly reject Manchester United; no assumption from raw slot index

stages.candidateKeys: UP, DOWN, confirm only on proven entry
stages.safety: Never commit a transfer or purchase

stages.candidateKeys: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, L1, R1
stages.safety: Kryvbas is modded team; stock 2001 order is invalid

stages.goal: Move across each of 22 player rows
stages.candidateKeys: DOWN/UP, page keys only when proven
stages.safety: One raw slot is not proof of a separate footballer

stages.goal: Verify 22 unique refs, complete screenshots and VAT
stages.safety: Check independent rendered club and player identity

menuTheory.claim: Master League is a top-level mode with NEW GAME and LOAD GAME
Master League contains 24 clubs; 16 in Division 1 and 8 in Division 2
Points can be used to acquire players in Master League
One guide lists O=confirm/X=cancel; other European-derived menu priors favor CROSS confirmation; must calibrate from emulator
Kryvbas replaces one of 24 club slots in the ISS26 mod; original GameFAQs roster indices cannot identify it

evidenceToCollect: visible chosen own club name other than MU
for each of 22 slots screenshot+VRAM, stable 44-byte roster ref bank, selected group/index
passPolicy: Requires independently reviewed semantic evidence for every named screen, own club !=Manchester United, target==FC Kryvbas, 22 different player references with distinct screenshots. Raw-byte counter and press sequence are candidates, never PASS.
failurePolicy: After 5 minutes, incomplete or unproven route receives no PASS; retain reports to improve future training.
